findings_to_judge.finding: Heidmar's earnings releases are the mechanical trigger for refreshing the resale prospectus covering 11,080,332 shares for B. Riley Principal Capital II: the 424B3 filed 2026-03-24 exists solely to supplement the 20 June 2025 prospectus 'with the information contained in our report on Form 6-K, filed with the SEC on March 24, 2026' - the same day as the Q4 print. The same pattern holds for 2025-08-12 (two 424B3s the day after the 2025-08-11 print), 2025-09-29 (424B3 and 6-K same day) and 2025-11-06, and a POS AM followed the Q1 print by two days. That resale registration was re-declared effective 2026-06-10, so 2026-09-01 is the first print under the refreshed shelf, and 11,080,332 shares is 170% of the company's entire non-affiliate share count.

The two-analyst FY2026 revenue forecast of $74.29m implies roughly $18.6m per quarter for Q2-Q4 against Q1 2026 actual of $18.4m - i.e. essentially flat, and below Q4 2025's $25.1m - while the spot rates that drive both of Heidmar's revenue lines rose 47-82% sequentially in Q2 (Frontline realised VLCC $103,500 to $152,700/day, Suezmax $72,400 to $111,500/day, LR2/Aframax $50,700 to $92,400/day, Q1 to Q2 2026), and the five vessels added in March/April 2026 contribute a full quarter for the first time. Heidmar's Q1 revenue was $5.68m trade revenues plus $12.67m voyage and time charter revenues from eight vessels employed on short-term spot/TC voyages versus one a year earlier; the Q2 2025 comparative is $9.6m total revenue and $0.5m adjusted net income.

Heidmar's fee-earning commercially managed fleet was effectively flat through Q2 2026: the 2025 Form 20-F filed 2026-04-30 states 'The Capital vessels compose 25 of the 49 vessels currently managed by Heidmar', while the 2026-07-07 release states the company manages 'around 50 vessels under commercial management and 16 vessels under technical management' - and that is after an acquisition (Q-Shipping B.V., effective 2026-07-01) that the company itself says added nine vessels to the managed fleet. Heidmar has issued no fleet-addition press release since 2026-05-19, the longest such gap since the de-SPAC, against five additions announced for Q1.

Heidmar has had no Chief Financial Officer since 31 May 2026 - Niki Fotiou ceased in the role and CEO Pankaj Khanna took over 'the finance function' pending a search - and no successor has been announced as of 2026-08-31, three months later. Q2 2026 is therefore the first quarter this company has closed, audited-reviewed and reported without a CFO. Separately, Heidmar has furnished no Form 6-K since 2026-05-28 despite three subsequent material announcements (CFO departure, Nasdaq compliance regained, Q-Shipping acquisition).

Only 6,498,572 of Heidmar's 58,991,997 outstanding shares are held by non-affiliates - an 11.0% float worth about $9.0m at spot - against 20-day average volume of 50,189 shares and short interest of just 127,609 shares. The prospectus states verbatim: 'As of May 20, 2026, we had 58,991,997 Common Shares outstanding, of which 6,498,572 shares were held by non-affiliates of our company.'

Three Heidmar directors filed Form 144s to sell 244,862 shares between 2026-06-11 and 2026-07-06 - Andreas Konialidis 113,287 shares ($165,400), Vasileios Loutradis 126,575 shares ($138,699) and Andre Lockhorst 5,000 shares ($5,950) - equal to about 3.8% of the entire non-affiliate float and roughly five sessions of average volume. Both larger sellers were disposing of 104,954-share awards dated 2026-04-01, i.e. registering to sell within ten weeks of the grant. As a foreign private issuer there is no Form 4 to confirm execution.

Half of Heidmar's fee base sits with one related party that has just been separately capitalised: the 20-F states the Capital vessels are 25 of 49 managed vessels and 'accounted for 37% of our total revenues from the Pools during the year ended December 31, 2025', and Capital Tankers Corp. listed on Euronext Growth Oslo on 2026-03-17 after raising about USD 500m, with a fleet of 30 super-eco crude tankers of which 21 are newbuildings delivering 2026-2028 plus options on 13 more.
